title: Dangerous Mobs
description: Enemy Expansion: Dangerous, hostile and destructive mobs.
body:
**This mod is currently unfinished.  
This mod contains light elements of suspense.**

![DANGEROUS MOBS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/907fb62c249b9e4446cde1cc3618e55b38977e9d_0.webp)


# Introduction

Dangerous Mobs adds several mobs that are either dangerous, hostile or destructive and things made of their drops.

You will encounter various dangerous mobs in the Overworld, Nether and The End. The mobs on the surface and those under the caves of the Overworld are different. You'd better prepare iron equipment before venturing into the deepslate.  
Some of the challenging mobs are labeled as bosses although they do not show health bars. They are natually spawned your the world. 
~~Upgraded verson of these bosses can be summoned by your option.~~

You may obtain various valuable drops if you defeat these mobs. The stronger the mobs are, the more valuable awards you will gain.  
Various unique equipments, foods, and blocks can be crafted by ingredients dropped by these mobs.

![DANGEROUS MOBS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a70a1983cc2218f2d0db44a85b76a078099ab44.png)

# Future Plans

- More mobs, of course.
- More items, maybe.
- Upgraded bossees summoned by specific ritual.
- Another mod of biomes that may integrate with this mod.

Plans above may change or not be completed.
